ENGLISH MARCH — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ENGLISH MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only a describing word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only an action

3. When practising Critical Listening ● finding connections between ideas or incidents , cause-effe, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Critical Listening ● finding connections between ideas or incidents , cause-effe.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Critical Listening ● finding connections between ideas or incidents , cause-effe.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Critical Listening ● finding connections between ideas or incidents , cause-effe.
